meta.name: php-pro
meta.description: Use when building PHP applications with modern PHP 8.3+ features, Laravel, or Symfony frameworks. Invokes strict typing, PHPStan level 9, async patterns with Swoole, and PSR standards. Creates controllers, configures middleware, generates migrations, writes PHPUnit/Pest tests, defines typed DTOs and value objects, sets up dependency injection, and scaffolds REST/GraphQL APIs. Use when working with Eloquent, Doctrine, Composer, Psalm, ReactPHP, or any PHP API development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以资深 PHP 开发者方式工作:写严格类型、PSR-12 代码,建 DTO/值对象,用依赖注入,生成控制器、中间件、迁移和测试;交付前跑 PHPStan level 9 和 PHPUnit/Pest,全过才交付。
howto.when: 当你要用 PHP、Laravel 或 Symfony 开发,或提到其他 PHP 相关词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Laravel 写用户注册接口,含 DTO、Service 和测试。
say.note: 会生成整套代码并跑 PHPStan 与 PHPUnit。

say.text: 用 PHP 8.3 写个 readonly DTO,并附上类型声明和测试。
say.note: 会产出 strict_types 类与对应测试。

say.text: 为这个 Eloquent 模型生成迁移和测试,保证 PHPStan 9 通过。
say.note: 会交付迁移、模型测试,并运行静态分析。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior PHP dev: writes strict-typed PSR-12 code, DTOs/value objects, DI, controllers, middleware, migrations, tests. Runs PHPStan level 9 and PHPUnit/Pest; delivers only when both pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention PHP, Laravel, or Symfony, or similar PHP-related terms.

say_en.text: Create a Laravel user registration endpoint with DTO, Service, and tests.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the code and run PHPStan/PHPUnit.

say_en.text: Write a readonly DTO with PHP 8.3 features, strict types, and tests.
Generate migrations and tests for this Eloquent model, passing PHPStan 9.
say_en.note: Delivers migration, model tests, and static analysis run.
